regions.merged_text: God Bless you Dear James - but now I must God bless Father James, So at long last and hearty Congratulations. I started to write a couple times since receiving your personal letter and now I feel almost too late. Anyway I am remembering you and all the folks over on Colorado and hope to see you Sunday.
